entries.title: The Beast Inside

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release for capture; no console emulation route is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC release is the best route because it is the original full release with PC capture/settings flexibility. Later PlayStation, Xbox, and Switch releases make the game available on consoles, but there is no sourced platform-exclusive story or mode content that outweighs the PC route.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Beast Inside on Steam and play the Windows PC build; check first if you want to adjust Unreal Engine 4 display behavior before capture.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Unreal Engine 4 PC release with PC settings and capture flexibility.
all_releases.reason: primary: original and best capture/fidelity route for the complete game.

all_releases.fidelity: Console release on current and previous PlayStation hardware.
all_releases.reason: skip: same game route, with no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC.

all_releases.fidelity: Console release with Xbox Series X/S optimization features.
all_releases.reason: skip: strong console route, but no sourced exclusive content over Windows PC and less flexible for PC capture/settings.
skip: useful handheld route, but no sourced exclusive content and lower capture/fidelity priority than Windows PC.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content route is needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No separate remaster or content-complete edition is documented.
